name: Stirling PDF 3 Self-Hosted PDF Toolkit
description: 50+ PDF tools in your browser: merge, split, OCR, convert, sign. Login on.

PORT.description: HTTP port (public domain target and healthcheck).

SECURITY_ENABLELOGIN.description: Require login. Stays on while the service has a public domain.

SECURITY_INITIALLOGIN_USERNAME.description: First admin user, created on the first boot only.

SECURITY_INITIALLOGIN_PASSWORD.description: First admin password, generated at deploy (12-128 characters). Change it later in Account settings.

SECURITY_CUSTOMGLOBALAPIKEY.description: API key for scripts (X-API-KEY header). At least 24 characters; empty disables it.

SYSTEM_DEFAULTLOCALE.description: Default interface language, e.g. en-US, de-DE, fr-FR, tr-TR.

SYSTEM_GOOGLEVISIBILITY.description: Let search engines index the login page.

SERVER_FORWARDHEADERSSTRATEGY.description: Trust Railway's proxy headers so links and redirects use https.

JAVA_CUSTOM_OPTS.description: Optional extra JVM flags, e.g. -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=60. Heap is sized from the service memory limit by default.

STIRLING_AOT_ENABLE.description: Build a JVM AOT cache on first boot for faster restarts (uses extra CPU and RAM once).
